{{Short description|Albanian writer and dissident}}
[[File:Lubonja1.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Fatos Lubonja in [[Warsaw]] in 2006]]

'''Fatos Lubonja''' (born 1951) is an [[Albania]]n writer and dissident.<ref name=Cook2001>{{cite encyclopedia |year=2001 |title=Lubonja, Fatos |encyclopedia=Europe since 1945: An Encyclopedia |publisher=Garland Publishing |url=https://www.questia.com/read/108806540 |editor=Bernard A. Cook |volume=2 |pages=797 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090430143740/https://www.questia.com/read/108806540 |archive-date=2009-04-30 |via=[[Questia]] |url-access=subscription |author=Bernard A. Cook}}</ref>

== Life ==
Lubonja was born in 1951. He attended the [[University of Tirana]] for his education. Lubonja was in jail from 1972 to 1991 as a [[political prisoner]].<ref name=Cook2001/> 

He is an outspoken critic of Albanian socio-political factors, i.e. [[right-wing]] leader [[Sali Berisha]], [[Socialist Party of Albania|Socialist Party]] leader [[Edi Rama]], former [[Kosovo Liberation Army|KLA]] leader [[Ramush Haradinaj]], the [[Red and Black Alliance]], and [[Ismail Kadare]]. Lubonja works for ''[[Përpjekja]]'' (Endeavour), which was founded by him in 1994.<ref>{{cite web|title=Arts and Culture Program|url=http://www.soros.al/en/legacy/art.htm#1|work=Open Society Foundation|access-date=3 May 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Fatos Lubonja|url=http://wordswithoutborders.org/contributor/fatos-lubonja|work=Words without Borders|access-date=3 May 2015}}</ref> In 1997, he received the prize "Archivio Disarmo - Golden Doves for Peace" from IRIAD.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Golden Doves for Peace |url=https://www.archiviodisarmo.it/golden-doves-for-peace.html |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=www.archiviodisarmo.it}}</ref>

Lubonja received the [[SEEMO Award for Mutual Cooperation in South East Europe]] in 2004.<ref>{{cite web|title=Human Rights Award 2004|url=http://seemo.org/awards/human/human04.html|work=SEEMO|access-date=3 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304102838/http://seemo.org/awards/human/human04.html|archive-date=4 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref> He wrote about communism with ''[[The Last Massacre]]''.{{fact|date=April 2021}} His book "[[False Apocalypse]]" was translated into English and published in London by [[Istros Books]] in 2014.{{fact|date=April 2021}}
